visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with short dark hair wearing a charcoal grey t-shirt is seated at a white modern counter, looking down at a smartphone in his hands. A young girl with long dark hair, wearing a white t-shirt under a blue and white tie-dye dress, stands beside him, speaking with an expressive face and hand gestures. The background is a modern apartment interior with a grey textured wall, a dark shelf, and a doorway leading to another room. (2) The scene cuts to a living room with a light grey sofa. The man is sitting on the sofa, focused on playing a handheld gaming console. A teenage girl in a pale yellow top and the young girl from the previous scene stand in front of him, looking disgruntled and pointing while talking. A small white dog is visible on the rug near the sofa. (3) In a study room, the man sits in a black leather executive office chair in front of a glass display cabinet filled with various colorful figurines and toys. A woman with bright pink hair tied back, wearing a dark grey t-shirt, stands behind him, leaning one hand on the chair as she speaks to him. (4) Back in the living room, the woman and the two girls are sitting together on the sofa with exaggeratedly sad and frustrated facial expressions. The man enters the frame from the side, holding a sleek grey tablet and smiling broadly. (5) A series of close-up shots showcase the new tablet. The screen displays a vibrant user interface with icons for Netflix, Spotify, and YouTube. A white charging cable is shown being plugged into the bottom port. A hand is seen using a digital stylus to write on the screen, and the tablet is placed on a smartphone to demonstrate reverse charging. (6) The entire family is gathered in the living room. The man holds the tablet prominently towards the camera while the others look on. Large, colorful text overlays with pink and yellow backgrounds appear on the screen at the bottom.
